title: Special Executive Programme In Corporate Governance Responsibilities
description: Understand the role of ethics and corporate governance in fostering responsible business behaviour.
longDescription: This programme delves into business ethics, ethical decision-making, and their impact on corporate governance. Participants will explore ethical frameworks, stakeholder roles, and governance mechanisms to ensure ethical behavior in organizations.
courseDetails: Explain ethical theories their strengths, limitations and applications to real-world business scenarios. Criticise and compare ethical theories. Discuss the impact of ethical considerations on business performance and sustainability. Apply ethical decision-making frameworks and tools, such as ethical impact assessments and codes of conduct, to real-world business scenarios. Evaluate the impact of cultural and social norms on ethical decision-making and behaviour in organisations. Identify and evaluate ethical dilemmas organisations may face and propose solutions using ethical theories and frameworks. Analyse real-world scenarios involving common business ethics. Identify common business ethics problem areas such as conflicts of interest, bribery, and discrimination. Resolve Ethical dilemmas in Business areas. Analyse real-world examples of business ethics in practice and evaluate the effectiveness of the ethical theories and decision-making frameworks used. Discuss the importance of implementing effective monitoring and reporting mechanisms to prevent and detect unethical behaviour in organisations. Propose potential solutions for resolving the problem areas. Analyse real-world scenarios involving common business ethics problem areas and evaluate potential solutions and strategies for resolution. Analyse the role of boards of directors, shareholders’ rights and responsibilities, and stakeholder management in corporate governance. Evaluate the importance of balancing the interests of different stakeholders in corporate governance. Discuss various monitoring concepts for corporate governance, such as corporate governance codes and regulations, corporate governance reporting, whistle-blowing and internal controls, audits, and ethical codes. Analyse the importance of monitoring in ensuring ethical behaviour within organisations. Evaluate the role of individuals, organisations, and society in monitoring and promoting ethical behaviour in the corporate world. Analyse the interconnection between business ethics and corporate governance and the impact of each on responsible corporate behaviour. Discuss the role of individuals, organisations, and society in promoting business ethics and effective corporate governance. Apply ethical decision-making frameworks and tools to real-world business scenarios, considering ethical considerations and corporate governance principles. Discuss the role of ethical leadership in promoting business ethics and effective corporate governance. The course begins by defining business ethics and its historical evolution, examining how ethical considerations shape corporate decision-making. Participants will explore ethical theories and apply them to real-world business dilemmas. The programme also addresses common business ethics problems, such as conflicts of interest and bribery, and highlights monitoring mechanisms like audits and whistle-blowing. Finally, participants will analyze the relationship between corporate governance and business ethics, emphasizing ethical leadership and stakeholder management. After the successful completion of the course, you will be able to learn about the following: Understanding the Foundations of Business Ethics: Analysing Ethical Theories And Their Relevance In Ethical Practice: Identifying and Resolving Common Business Ethics Problem Areas: Understanding Ethical Governance Perspectives: Business Ethics, Corporate Governance and Organizational Behaviour:

It aims to equip participants with tools to address ethical dilemmas and promote responsible corporate governance.
